remarks: Enjoy the best of Stamford living in this beautifully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath rental just a short walk from Cove Island Park. Featuring a bright, open-concept floor plan, this inviting home offers a seamless flow between the modern eat-in kitchen and spacious living area-perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or working from home. The updated kitchen boasts contemporary finishes and ample dining space, while the generously sized bedroom and renovated bath provide comfort and style. Off-street parking adds everyday convenience. Ideally located with easy access to I-95, the train station, downtown Stamford, shopping, restaurants, nightlife, and entertainment, this rental combines a peaceful neighborhood setting with unbeatable accessibility. Spend your weekends enjoying the beach, walking trails, and waterfront views at nearby Cove Island Park, then return home to a space you'll love coming back to. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy a move-in-ready rental in one of Stamford's most convenient and desirable locations.
